summary: HDFC Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing details of a USD 750 million senior unsecured bond issuance. The bank, acting through GIFT City IFSC Banking Unit, issued the five-year bonds dated June 24, 2026 to June 24, 2031, with a coupon of 5.067% payable semi-annually. The notes are rated Baa3/BBB and are unsecured. Proceeds will be used for banking activities. The bonds will be listed on India International Exchange and NSE IFSC. This is an ordinary debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
